SpaceMiT K1. All latency rows are one-core warm inference; comparisons are within rows, never across model/datatype groups. Dagger: cross-run; double dagger: timeout lower bound / seeded-random reference.
FP32 VLA rows are deterministic reduced-depth captures with generated parameters—not pretrained task-quality benchmarks. Each FP32 native arm uses its search-selected general schedule; immutable weight layouts are AOT-prepacked in both native and hybrid arms.
